about: How kisi reads a target impedance from a KiCad net class name when <board>.kisi.json gives none (docs/reference.md, 'Target impedance from net class names'). The upper-cased name is split into runs of letters and numbers; a number within range_ohm counts when a unit follows it (50Z, USB_90R, 100Ohm), a prefix stands right before it (Z85, SE50, S50, Diff_100, diff90, ZDIFF=100, SE55DE100: one separator of '_', '-', '=' or a space allowed), or – with neither – a kind word follows it (100_DIFF, 50_SE). Prefixes and kind words of 'single' and 'diff' fix the kind; 'plain' prefixes and units leave it to the name: differential when a diff_keywords entry occurs in it, or at diff_hint.min_ohm and more with a diff_hint keyword. Short prefixes (up to two letters) must be the whole letter run (S50, not BUS50); longer ones may end it (USBDIFF90). Two different values of one kind (SE50_SE60) give no target; one single-ended and one differential value (SE55DE100) give the differential target, with the single-ended value named in the source. The source of such a target is 'class name': what the designer wrote, shown with the class, not an estimate of kisi's. Without a number, an interface keyword (interfaces) gives the usual impedance of that interface, marked 'interface assumption'. These lists are naming conventions seen on real boards (the kicad-happy corpus, data/corpus.json); extend them when boards use other names – a test in crates/kisi-si/src/classname.rs keeps the examples.

sources.text: Range of PCB trace impedances (single-ended and differential); numbers outside it in a class name are widths, data rates or voltages, not impedances.
USB, LVDS and PCIe signals are differential pairs; a value of 80 Ω or more in such a class name is their differential impedance.
USB 2.0 HS: 90 Ω ±15 % differential (profile usb2 in data/interfaces.json).
TI SNLA426: PCIe allows 70–100 Ω, add-in cards require 85 Ω (profiles pcie3–pcie5 in data/interfaces.json).

TIA/EIA-644: 100 Ω differential (profile lvds in data/interfaces.json).
HDMI TMDS: 100 Ω ±10 % differential (profile hdmi20 in data/interfaces.json).

Serial ATA: 100 Ω nominal differential impedance of the board traces.
